cases.letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the Python Developer role at Acme Data, as advertised on Remotive. As a final-year BSc Information Systems student with a focus on data operations, I am eager to apply my technical proficiency to your data initiatives.

My academic projects demonstrate a bias-to-action and a commitment to delivering measurable outcomes. I recently developed a courier ETA predictor that reduced mean absolute error by 14% compared to the baseline, highlighting my ability to build predictive models that provide tangible value. Furthermore, I automated weekly operations KPIs to save two hours of manual effort each week and classified support tickets with a precision of 0.86. These experiences have refined my ability to perform complex data cleaning and generate actionable insights from raw data.

I possess a strong foundation in Python, SQL and statistics, complemented by practical experience in A/B testing and dashboard development using Looker and Tableau. My technical toolkit includes working with APIs and JSON structures. My approach is defined by structured thinking and concise communication, ensuring that technical outputs remain clearly aligned with broader project objectives.

Working in a remote capacity aligns well with my professional habits. I am keen to contribute to the data challenges at Acme Data and I am eager to learn any tools I have not yet used.

I am currently available for part-time engagement, with full-time availability commencing in June 2026. Thank you for your time and consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can contribute to your team.

Yours faithfully,
Your Name
